name: Grizzled Scalp
summary: South of Auberdine, grizzled thistle bears roam Darkshore’s forests, and their thick hides find a use with Wizbang Cranktoggle.

sections.title: A Peculiar Fermentation
sections.body: South of Auberdine, grizzled thistle bears roam the road, their rough pelts sought by hunters. Four scalps brought to Buzzbox 525 reveal their purpose. Wizbang Cranktoggle uses hidden buzzboxes scattered across Darkshore as stills. Night elves frown on illicit brewing in their settlements, so Wizbang relies on adventurers to gather bear scalps and other strange ingredients for his beloved thistle bear beer.

faq.q: Where can I find Grizzled Scalps?
faq.answer: Grizzled thistle bears and their matriarch, the Den Mother, roam the forests south of Auberdine along Darkshore’s main trail.

faq.q: What are Grizzled Scalps used for?
aliases: what do i do with grizzled scalps
faq.answer: Deposit the scalps in Buzzbox 525, a mechanical terminal hidden in the bushes beside the road far south of Auberdine.

faq.q: Why does Buzzbox 525 need bear scalps?
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle uses his hidden buzzbox network to distill liquor away from night elf eyes. The scalps go into his thistle bear beer.

faq.q: Why is Wizbang hiding his brewing in Darkshore's wilderness?
faq.answer: Wizbang hides his stills in the wilderness brush because the night elves of Auberdine object to unauthorized, noisy brewing in their sacred groves. The hidden contraptions keep his moonshine operation out of sight.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see how gnomish skill disguises automated brewing stills as field repair communication arrays.
As a night elf, you protect Darkshore’s wildlife and look askance at wanton poaching and gnomish stills hidden in the wilderness.
